purpose: Teach: ヌード/ピュア/パンドラ/ノア/聖母/ジミー/スーザン/アンディ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「美術館でヌードクロッキーの展示を観に行く」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad mentioned he's going to see a life drawing exhibition at the art museum.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational tone. Warm observation, like sharing something small she noticed. Unhurried, with soft curiosity beneath — testing the water.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ピュアな気持ちを大事にね」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me to treasure keeping a pure heart.
lines.style: Sincere and earnest, no performance. Direct eye contact in his voice. Small and steady, the way he speaks about things that matter to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「パンドラの箱は開けるなって寓話」を教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad shared that old story about Pandora's box — you know, the one about not opening what shouldn't be opened.
lines.style: Tender, reflective cadence. Choosing words carefully, like she's thinking aloud. Warm gaze in the voice — she's connecting something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとノアの方舟の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read the picture book about Noah's ark together.
lines.style: Bright and present. Small warmth in the middle of the sentence — pride in the shared moment. Light, genuine, no filter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「聖母マリア像の絵画集を観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he wants to look at a collection of paintings of the Virgin Mary together.
lines.style: Soft, reflective voice. There's a quietness here — she's noticing the pattern, not stating it. Warm but measured, like she's gathering something together in her mind.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとジミー・ニュートロンのアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched that anime about Jimmy Neutron.
lines.style: Excited but grounded — he's telling her something, not performing. Quick delivery, natural rhythm. A small smile underneath, genuine pleasure in the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「スーザンっていう英語名の意味」を教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to tell you what the name Susan means in English.
lines.style: Reflective, patient voice. There's a knowing quality — she's seen where this is heading. Warm and gentle, no judgment. Trailing thought at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「アンディ」って名前の絵本キャラ見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I saw a picture book character named Andy.
lines.style: Bright, eager, the words tumbling out naturally. Trusting voice — he's not worried, just sharing. Small and genuine, the closing warmth of a child telling you something simple and true.
